member.name: T:LibProsperoPkg.Content.ProsperoFself
member.summary: Reader and producer for the SELF container used by PS5 executable modules.
member.remarks:
Layout (little-endian scalars):
SCE header, 0x20 bytes: magic 0x1D3D154F, version/mode/endian/attr bytes, program type, header size, metadata size, file size, segment count, flags.
Segment table at 0x20, one 0x20-byte entry per segment: flags, file offset, file size, memory size. Content segments come in pairs (a zero-filled digest segment then the data segment).
ELF header and program headers, copied verbatim.
Extended info (0x40) after the program headers: authority id, program type, versions, and the SHA-256 of the input ELF.
A zero-filled metadata footer, then the plaintext segment data.
The original non-allocated .sceversion section appended after the SELF size recorded in the header. Publishing Tools use this trailer for SDK/library-version validation.

member.name: T:LibProsperoPkg.Content.ProsperoUcp
member.summary: Reader and producer for the UCP archive format used by the trophy and user-data-system components of a PS5 package.
member.remarks:
Layout (big-endian scalars):
Header, 0x60 bytes: 0x00 u32 magic 0xB228C60A; 0x04 u32 version (1); 0x08 u64 total file size; 0x10 u32 entry count; 0x14 u32 entry-record size (0x40); 0x18 u32 zero; 0x1C 20-byte SHA-1 digest; 0x30..0x60 reserved zero.
Entry table at 0x60, one 0x40-byte record per entry: 32-byte name (NUL-padded), u64 offset, u64 size, 16 reserved bytes.
Blob region: entries in ascending name order, each blob followed by padding to the next 16-byte boundary (a full 16 bytes when the end is already aligned); the file size is padded the same way. The digest covers the whole file with the digest field held zero.

— a single <rootdir> with a src_path (and optional exclude masks) that the tool walks recursively, preceded by <global_exclude>.

member.name: M:LibProsperoPkg.PFS.Compression.Oodle.KrakenDecoder.DecodeBlock(System.ReadOnlySpan{System.Byte},System.Int32,System.Int32,System.Span{System.Byte})
member.summary: Decodes a whole PFS block (the section-7 payload) into (sized to the block's exact uncompressed length). is the block's on-disk boundary flag byte; is the first sub-chunk's compressed size (from the boundary size hint) and is only consulted when the block spans two sub-chunks (its uncompressed size exceeds one 128 KiB chunk). A two-chunk block's sub-chunks have INDEPENDENT types — each is newLZ or a bare-entropy Kraken_DecodeBytes array selected by (chunk0: bit 0x02; chunk1: bit 0x20) — so they are decoded separately. Unless its restart bit is set, the second is seedless and may back-reference the first. The literal model comes from its low bit (chunk0 0x01, chunk1 0x10): set = sub/delta, clear = raw. Chunk1 flag 0x40 starts that sub-chunk from a fresh output window; otherwise a newLZ chunk1 may back-reference chunk0.

member.name: T:LibProsperoPkg.PFS.Compression.Oodle.OodleKrakenEncoder
member.summary:
Managed Kraken (newLZ) encoder. Compresses a PFS block into one or two headerless newLZ "excess mode" chunks that round-trip through the PS5 block decompressor.
Length escapes. A literal run longer than 257 bytes (packed value litLen-3 >= 255) and a match longer than (packed value matchLen-17 >= 255) are carried by a 0xFF packed_litlen marker plus a u32 escape value. Every escape in a chunk is collected in packed_litlen order and written into a trailing excess sub-stream, split even index -> forward writer / odd index -> backward writer and laid out forward ++ reverse(backward), mirroring the paired readers the decoder uses. The post-seed control byte is 0x80 | low6(excessByteCount) with a continuation byte when the count exceeds 0x1F. Over-long matches are split into <= pieces so in practice only literal runs escape; a chunk needing more than escapes falls back to the stored path.
No match may start in the last (16) bytes of a chunk. The newLZ release parse loop enforces match_zone_end - to_ptr >= lrl where match_zone_end = chunk_end - 16: the literal-run end (= match start) must be <= chunk_end - 16. A match that starts later drifts the decode pointer and the block is rejected with error -1007. The parser therefore stops emitting matches past chunkEnd - NoMatchZone and flushes the remainder as the trailing literal run; a store-raw safety net rejects any chunk that would still violate it.
Returns null when compression is not worthwhile (caller stores the block).

member.name: M:LibProsperoPkg.PFS.Compression.Oodle.OodleKrakenEncoder.Parse(System.ReadOnlySpan{System.Byte},System.Int32[],System.Int32[],System.Int32,System.Int32,System.Int32,System.Int32)
member.summary:
Value-model lazy parse over the output range, a faithful managed implementation of the reference greedy optimal pre-pass (the implementation). Each candidate match is scored by the exact value function ( / match value):len*4 - (isRep ? 0 : bitlen(dist)+2) — validated from algorithm + algorithm (bitlen = 32 - clz). Repeat-offset matches transmit no offset, so they cost 0 there and are strongly preferred; among new offsets the finder keeps the highest value and, on a value tie, the SHORTEST distance (the hash chain is walked most-recent-first, so the nearer offset is seen first and wins the tie). Picking the nearer offset on ties seeds a reusable recent-offset that subsequent positions re-use as cheap reps — exactly the rep-reuse cascade the parser produces (e.g. introducing dist=57 then reusing it for hundreds of commands instead of walking dist=552,553,554...).
A 2-step lazy look-ahead defers the match start while a later position yields a strictly better match, using the exact comparator and thresholds: defer by 1 when value(pos+1) - value(cur) - 4 >= 1, else defer by 2 when value(pos+2) - value(cur) - 4 >= 4, else emit cur (the +4 incumbent bias and the <1/<4 gates are algorithm's).
Matches never start past (the match_zone_end, chunkEnd-16) nor extend past (chunkEnd-8), preserving the trailing literal run.

The logical block size (default 256 KiB). Must be positive.

When true (the default), the literal/command/length streams within each chunk are Huffman-coded (entropy chunk type 2) where that is smaller than the raw form, producing markedly smaller blocks. Pass false for raw entropy arrays (larger, useful for debugging/determinism). Both forms round-trip exactly through the decoder.
Allows the managed encoder to select the sub/delta literal model. Disable this for conservative kernel-facing streams.
Allows one half of a 256-KiB block to be stored while the other half remains compressed. Disable this for conservative kernel-facing streams.

Uses the validated Prospero Publishing Tools Oodle Reduced encoder required by the A53 hardware path. If that optional DLL is unavailable, blocks are stored rather than emitted with the software-only managed Kraken profile.
Optional explicit path to the supported Publishing Tools DLL used by the Reduced encoder.
Stores all blocks without calling either Kraken encoder.
PFSv2 legacy header/table or PFSv3 section-directory format.

SHA3-256 is unavailable on this host.

member.name: M:LibProsperoPkg.PFS.Compression.ProsperoPfsDigest.ComputeFileDigest(System.ReadOnlySpan{System.Byte},System.ReadOnlySpan{System.Byte},System.ReadOnlySpan{System.Byte},System.ReadOnlySpan{System.Byte})
member.summary: Computes the container's file-level SHA3-256 digest (stored at header offset 0x28), using the target format's file-digest algorithm.
member.param: Exactly (24) bytes copied verbatim from the container header at offsets 0x08..0x20 (block size, encode parameters, and uncompressed size).
The shuffle-pattern metadata section bytes (directory id=2).
The block-boundary table bytes (directory id=3).
The per-block hash table bytes (directory id=4).
member.remarks: The preimage is header32 || shuffleSection || boundarySection || blockHashSection, where header32 is a 32-byte, 8-byte-aligned little-endian struct: {u32 1; u32 blockSize; u32 encodeParam0C; u32 0 (pad); u64 encodeParam10; u64 uncompressedSize}. This layout applies to independent encoder outputs (compressed and stored blocks).
member.exception: is not 24 bytes.
SHA3-256 is unavailable on this host.

member.summary: When set before writing an image, captures the sce_sys/imagedigs.dat preimage into : one per-block descriptor digest for every block of the plaintext signed image, stored from last byte to first. member.name: M:LibProsperoPkg.PFS.ProsperoPs5InnerImageAssembler.BuildBlockInfoTable(System.Int64)
member.summary:
Builds the 256-byte inner block-75 table that precedes the compressed metadata block. Each 8-byte entry is { u32 value, u32 version } (little-endian): the first 31 entries carry ; the final entry is derived from the logical end of all afid files.
The final entry, read as the three displayed bytes, equals 0x27FFFC − 4·(afidDataEnd mod 0x10000). For the publisher baseline afidDataEnd=0xA this produces 27 FF D4; for the compressed AC sample afidDataEnd mod 0x10000=0x8C it produces 27 FD CC. A larger 0x2B482 tail uses 0xB482 and produces 25 2D F4.
member.param: Logical end of all afid file data, including sce_sys files.

member.summary: Builds the 0x10000-byte finalized-image (FIH) header block. This is a SHARED, cycle-free helper used by both the standalone FIH writer () and the PS5 CNT builder so the fixed-info-digest (SHA3-256 of this block) is self-consistent. The image-content slot 0xB0 is the publisher nested-layout digest: when is supplied by the PPR/NAPS CNT build path it is SHA3-256(naps_pkg_layout.dat); when it is null (the standalone finalize path, which only has the finished encrypted CNT) it falls back to the best-effort SHA3-256(outer image). Cycle-free either way: both inputs are final before the CNT digest table is computed (using the embedded CNT metadata here would create a digest cycle).

member.name: T:LibProsperoPkg.PKG.ProsperoNapsLayoutBuilder
member.summary: Generator for the PS5 naps_pkg_layout.dat CblockInfo/u2c/fidx sections. Walks a per-block compression plan with a compressed-offset cursor and emits a that serializes from modeled fields.

list.item: A RUN-base record re-bases the compressed cursor: coffEnd = cursor mod 0x40000 (captured before the reset), CoffsetStart256K = floor(onDisk/0x40000), TweakIdxStart = onDisk >> 16 (0 for the terminator), then the cursor resets to onDisk.

A STD record: CoffsetStartMod256K = cursor mod 0x40000, UoffsetStart = logical mod 0x40000, ClenEvenMinus1 = min(evenComp-1, 0x1FFFF), plus the even/odd/kde/shuf flags. The cursor then advances by the block's stream length.
The terminator STD is a sentinel at the mount boundary: reserved bit 19 is set, ClenEvenMinus1 = 0, and all mode flags are zero.

u2c packs a per-ublock "first CblockInfo index" table I[u] = the index of the first STD whose logical start >= u*0x40000 (missing ublocks point at the terminator index), in a phase-shifted 8-block grouping.

Builds the encrypted naps_meta_18.dat metric blob for a finalized image. The plaintext TLV carries the inner-image geometry (phdr), the content-file table (file/fstr), the per-block info tables (ibcl/i2ob/i2op/ihsh/rhsh) with real block digests over , the outer digest (obdg), a fixed marker (twek) and the four 48-byte descriptor records (pgpl/pgil/pgpi/pgpu). The stream is padded to a 16-byte multiple and AES-128-XTS encrypted.
member.param: Block-aligned inner-image size (finalized-image header offset 0xA0).
The finalized FIH+PFS+CNT mount image; block digests are computed over it.
Inner content files in load order: relative path and plain size.

When supplied, the per-block info tables (ibcl/i2ob/i2op/ihsh) and the file record describe the compressed inner-image NAPS block map (afid raw extents + data-region hole ublocks + metadata ublocks) instead of an identity map over the outer . When (legacy inners), the exact previous outer-block behavior is kept. obdg/rhsh stay over the outer image in both cases.

member.name: M:LibProsperoPkg.PKG.ProsperoNapsMeta.BuildOuterBlockCheckCodes(LibProsperoPkg.PKG.ProsperoNapsIntegrityContext,System.Threading.CancellationToken,System.Action{System.String})
member.summary: Builds the publisher obcc table for a fresh NAPS image. The native 2.79 path derives the XTS keys as D = HMAC-SHA256(pfs-image-key, LE32(1) || pfs-image-seed), then encrypts every 64-KiB physical block with dataKey=D[16..31], tweakKey=D[0..15], and data-unit number equal to the physical block index. Each table entry is CRC32C of that temporary encrypted block in little-endian order. When no key pair is present, returns the correctly-sized all-zero table so a caller-supplied integrity provider can still override it.

member.summary: Publisher rhsh value for one input block. The rolling window is 64 KiB; shorter inputs are zero-padded and longer inputs use their first 64 KiB. The two 64-bit accumulators are combined as sum XOR (weighted << 25).

Builds the complete debug SI segment (the trailing sce_suppl ZIP) for a finalized nwonly image entirely from values the package build has already produced. config/<content-id>/playgo-chunk.crc computed by CRC-32C over the finalized mount image.

member.name: M:LibProsperoPkg.PlayGo.ProsperoPlayGo.BuildChunkCrc(System.ReadOnlySpan{System.Byte})
member.summary: Builds the PS5 sce_suppl/config/<content-id>/playgo-chunk.crc by reducing the finalized mount image with CRC-32C (Castagnoli) in 64KiB blocks and serialising each block's checksum as a little-endian uint32, in block order. This reproduces the reference output byte-for-byte (validated against every debug sample in TestFiles/PS5/PKG/Debug). The is the FIH+PFS+SC region that precedes the SI segment (i.e. everything from offset 0 up to the SI archive); a reference mount image is always a whole number of 64KiB blocks, but a trailing partial block (if any) is reduced over its actual length for robustness.
member.param: The finalized mount image bytes (FIH header + PFS image + embedded CNT).
member.returns: The playgo-chunk.crc payload: 4 bytes per 64KiB block.

member.summary: Builds the PS5 sce_sys/playgo-hash-table.dat (CNT entry id 0x2010). member.name: P:LibProsperoPkg.ProsperoBuildOptions.InnerCompression
member.summary:
Selects the inner-image codec explicitly. When left at the legacy flag decides (true => ). When set to a non-None value this takes precedence over :
— zlib PFSC (installable inner image).
— PS5 PFSv2/v3 Kraken (the nwonly inner-image codec), validated against reference output. Incompressible images fall back to the raw wrapper automatically.

member.name: T:LibProsperoPkg.Util.RecoverableFileStream
member.summary: Keeps the pending transfer in an owned buffer until the OS write succeeds. FileStream's own buffering is disabled so a partial failed flush cannot leave hidden state that gets replayed. The stream is sequentially owned, just like FileStream; independent writers use independent streams.
